column3: System shall support five alert priority levels: Warning (L1), Caution (L2), Advisory (L3), Status (L4), Memo (L5)
column4: Standard alert taxonomy per industry practice

column3: Warning alerts (L1) shall be displayed in RED color with continuous or voice aural alert
column4: Visual and aural coding for immediate crew action

column3: Caution alerts (L2) shall be displayed in AMBER color with single chime or intermittent aural alert
column4: Visual and aural coding for timely crew awareness

column3: Advisory alerts (L3) shall be displayed in WHITE or CYAN color with no aural alert
System shall suppress lower priority alerts when higher priority alerts are active
Each alert message shall have unique message identifier
Alert messages shall be inhibited during critical flight phases per inhibit logic
column4: Reduce crew workload during high-workload phases

column3: System shall interface with ATA 22 for alert inhibit signals
Alert latency from trigger condition to display shall be < 500ms
Alert message database shall contain minimum: message ID, text, priority, color, aural type, triggering condition
System shall maintain alert integrity with no loss or corruption of active alerts
System shall provide alert data to FDR per recording parameter list
System shall support crew acknowledgment of caution alerts
System shall maintain master warning/caution light state consistent with active alerts
Alert display shall be readable in all ambient lighting conditions
